description: This Java source file defines the CoreEvents class which handles various web application events and services for the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for returning success/error placeholders, scheduling services, saving service results, running services, and streaming files, mainly intended for internal web event handling.

classes.name: CoreEvents
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to handle web application events such as service scheduling, execution, and file streaming within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: returnNull
methods.description: Returns null, used as a placeholder event.

methods.name: scheduleService
methods.description: Schedules a service for execution at a specific time or recurrence based on request parameters.

methods.name: saveServiceResultsToSession
methods.description: Saves results from a synchronous service call into the session for later retrieval.

methods.name: getObjectFromServicePath
methods.description: Extracts nested objects from service results given a path string, handling maps, entities, and collections.

methods.name: runService
methods.description: Executes a specified service, either synchronously or asynchronously, with security validation.

methods.name: streamFile
methods.description: Streams a file to the client based on the request path.
